title: BLS — Medical Equipment Repairers
evidence: May2025 median61,660;10th38,490;90th98,280;2025–35growth13%;8,200 annual openings; associate/certificate or alternate experience/training routes.

title: O*NET — Medical Equipment Repairers
evidence: Inspection, fault diagnosis, maintenance, records, tools, work context and technical skills.

title: ACCE — Clinical Engineer Defined
evidence: Engineering and managerial work in healthcare; clinical education and hospital internship; budgets, systems, assets, IT coordination and maintenance oversight.

title: AAMI — Healthcare Technology Management
evidence: HTM manages and repairs technology with clinicians; safety, security, interoperability and functionality.

title: AAMI — Certified Biomedical Equipment Technician
evidence: Full-status routes: qualifying associate/higher +2yr; military program+2yr;4yr BMET. Candidate eligibility separate.

title: AAMI — Certified Associate in Biomedical Technology
evidence: Introductory credential; at least high-school junior eligible with documentation. Does not establish full CBET equivalence.

title: AAMI — Certifications
evidence: Professional credential organization and examination process; not state clinical licensure.

title: FDA — Cybersecurity
evidence: Connected-device safety/security requires manufacturer and healthcare-organization collaboration; no unsourced patching instructions.

title: FDA — Human Factors and Medical Devices
evidence: User-device interaction, controls, displays, maintenance interfaces and reduction of use-related risk.

title: BLS — Clinical Laboratory Technologists and Technicians
evidence: Laboratory professionals perform specimen tests; distinct from equipment-service and design work.
